seed: Create standard SME chart of accounts

select.hint: Please select a chart of accounts first.

okey.label: okey
okey.helper: The okey is the key of an element, consisting of the prefix of the category and a sequential number, e.g. boat-001 for the first boat.

id.label: Account no.
id.helper: The unique number of the account.

name.label: Account name
name.error: The name is mandatory and must consist of alphanumeric characters.
name.helper: A name can consist of several words. Only letters (incl. -) and numbers are allowed, no special characters.

bank.label: Bank account
bank.description: An account held at a bank.

user.label: User account
user.description: A personal account of a user.

root.label: Chart of accounts
root.description: The root of a chart of accounts.

group.label: Account group
group.description: Groups further groups or accounts together.

leaf.label: Account
leaf.description: An account that bookings are posted to.

label.label: Label
label.error: The label is mandatory and must consist of alphanumeric characters.
label.helper: This text is shown to the user.

parentId.label: Parent account
parentId.helper: The number of the parent account. The parent account groups several accounts and thus forms the hierarchy in the chart of accounts.
